syllabus_topics: Purpose and content of the course
Basic elements (atomic forces, structure types, molar mass, determination of molar mass and distribution)
Morphology of polymers (amorphous and semi-crystalline polymers, crystal structure of polymers, kinetics of the crystallization process, measuring the degree of crystallization and kinetics)
Technical processes and their consequence for the structure of polymers
Structure and temperature (polymer molecules in the liquid phase, temperature effects in the solid phase, transitions, characterization of transition temperatures)
Deformation and fracture behavior of single polymers
Mechanical properties of composite plastics (plasticized plastics, polymer-polymer systems, filled plastics, polymer composites)
Electrical properties (action of electric fields, conductivity, dielectric properties)
Thermal properties (conductivity and specific heat, thermal expansion)
Structure-property relationships of specific plastic classes
Characterization of flow parameters of polymers (viscosity, elasticity, MFI)
Overview of techniques for processing thermoplastics (general processes, continuous processes, discontinuous processes)
Overview of techniques for processing thermosets
assessment_rules: The exam is closed book. Of the three questions, one is reviewed orally after written preparation.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
